blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Taxes can sound hard, but in English they follow simple patterns. In this lesson, "Employees and Taxes", you learn the words that appear on Czarnikow's forms and reports.

Today you learn five useful words. Then you practise them in short, natural sentences. The words are simple: staff, manager, colleague, client and supplier.

Go slowly — one step at a time. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: What is the name of this lesson?
items.why: O texto diz: "this lesson, 'Employees and Taxes'".

items.q: How many new words do you learn today?
items.why: "Today you learn five useful words."

items.q: Where do these words appear?
items.why: "the words that appear on Czarnikow's forms and reports".

items.q: The text says "Go slowly — one step at a time." This suggests the author wants you to…
options: take your time and not rush
items.why: Inferência: "one step at a time" mostra que o autor prefere calma, não pressa.

items.q: "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts." The author most likely wants you to feel…
options: confident that you can do it
items.why: Inferência: a frase e "You can do it!" passam confiança ao aluno.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie apresentar o time fiscal para os novos funcionários. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello, everyone, and welcome! My name is Sophie. Today I want to show you our tax team. We are a small group, but we work together every day.

This is our staff. We check the forms, and we send the reports on time. Our manager is very kind. You can ask her any question. She helps us a lot.

You will also meet your colleagues here. They are friendly, and they know the tax words very well. When you have a problem, they help you fast.

We work with clients and suppliers too. We check every client before the deadline. We keep the supplier files for seven years. It is simple, but it is important.

So, take your time. One step at a time. You can do it. Welcome to the team!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Who is speaking?
items.why: "My name is Sophie… I want to show you our tax team."

items.q: How does Sophie describe the manager?
items.why: "Our manager is very kind. You can ask her any question."

items.q: For how long do they keep the supplier files?
items.why: "We keep the supplier files for seven years."

items.q: Sophie says the team is small "but we work together every day." This suggests the team…
items.why: Inferência: mesmo pequena, a equipe colabora bem — trabalha junta todo dia.

items.q: How does Sophie most likely want the new employees to feel?
items.why: Inferência: "take your time", "You can do it" e "Welcome to the team" passam acolhimento e calma.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Our staff is ready for the meeting." A staff is…
options: the people who work in a company
items.why: Staff = equipe, as pessoas que trabalham na empresa.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "When I have a question, I ask my ___. She leads the team."
items.why: Manager = gerente, quem lidera a equipe.

items.q: "My colleague sits next to me at work." A colleague is…
options: a company that sells to you
a person who works with you
items.why: Colleague = colega, quem trabalha com você.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We check every ___ before the deadline, because they pay for our service."
items.why: Client = cliente, quem paga pelo serviço.

items.q: "The supplier sends us paper and pens." A supplier is…
options: a company that sells things to you
items.why: Supplier = fornecedor, empresa que vende produtos para você.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs simples que aparecem no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please fill out this tax form." To fill out means to…
items.why: Fill out = preencher, escrever as respostas no formulário.

items.q: "You must hand in the report before Friday." To hand in means to…
items.why: Hand in = entregar algo para alguém.

items.q: "The manager will sign off on the numbers." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "I will follow up with the client tomorrow." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar seguimento, checar de novo mais tarde.

items.q: "Let's go over the form together." To go over means to…
items.why: Go over = revisar, passar por cada parte com atenção.
